rules.title: .post-title
rules.notes: Substack ships hashed class names (title-X77sOw, subtitle-HEEcLo) alongside a few stable ones. The hashed names are exactly the case Readability's class and id heuristics cannot score, so pinning the stable pair is worth a rule. Publications on custom domains serve the same markup but need their own entry, since the host no longer ends in substack.com.
